features.description: Record the reviewed charter and one concrete pilot workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Record owner answers on first outcome, both streams, project independence, powered-by minimum, and infra-vr relationship with attribution.
Name one native check per pilot engine, initial platform/mode, required resources, success measurement and bounded effort budget.
Review the feature proposal and record accepted scope before activating features.json.

features.description: Specify a project adapter contract that preserves native commands and policies.
acceptance_criteria: Versioned schema represents repository identity, game target, progress/inventory paths, argv commands, working directory, verification tiers and capabilities.
Fixtures represent reLith NOLF/AVP2/NOLF2 and reSource without forcing common paths, ECS, SDL or CMake targets.
Reject malformed commands, missing required identities and unknown required contract versions; inspection does not execute commands.

features.description: Specify a verification result envelope with honest non-pass states.
acceptance_criteria: Contract records pass, fail, skip, infrastructure_error, timeout and pending_manual distinctly, with declared required checks.
Each check identifies command, tool/host revision, platform/profile, timestamps, raw-log reference and reason for a non-pass.
Negative fixtures prove that missing/skipped required checks and absent manual evidence cannot aggregate to passing.

features.description: Implement one local native-command runner with bounded process lifetime.
acceptance_criteria: Execute argv directly in an explicit workspace; preserve native exit status, stdout and stderr without shell interpolation.
Real child-process tests cover success, nonzero exit, timeout including child cleanup, missing executable and explicit skip mapping.
Inspection/plan mode performs no execution; first runner scope is the pilot platform from F1, with unsupported platforms reported explicitly.
features.deliverable: runner implementation and process integration evidence

features.description: Write immutable, verifiable run bundles from runner results.
acceptance_criteria: Bundle includes source revision plus dirty patch identity when relevant, adapter/tool version, declared check inventory, results and hashed logs.
Writes are atomic and existing run identities cannot be silently overwritten; partial/interrupted runs remain visibly incomplete.
Validator rejects tampered/missing artifacts and path traversal; valid bundle survives relocation without absolute sibling paths.

features.description: Describe and exercise the selected reLith check through a local adapter.
acceptance_criteria: Resolve current native check command from the host and identify NOLF, AVP2 and NOLF2 separately; use the F1-selected pilot target only.
In a prepared isolated host workspace, direct and wrapped invocation agree on results and relevant raw facts.
Adapter preserves source/assets identity and host gate requirements; it never changes the original host tracker or active worktree.

features.description: Describe and exercise the selected reSource check through a local adapter.
acceptance_criteria: Resolve the selected native check from the current host; encode everyday/slow/data/manual tiers without weakening required gates.
In a prepared isolated host workspace, direct and wrapped invocation agree without assuming reLith paths or binaries.
Record missing assets/tools as non-passes and leave the original host tracker and active worktree untouched.

features.description: Demonstrate the same tool on both real engine pilots.
acceptance_criteria: Archive validated bundles from actual native invocations in both selected engine snapshots and compare with their direct baselines.
Demonstrate at least one intentional non-pass that remains non-passing through aggregation; infrastructure problems are not hidden.
Record the F1 success measurement and whether the workflow earns further adoption; fixtures alone do not complete this feature.

features.description: Package a minimal agent-neutral harness template with local policy extension.
acceptance_criteria: Generate a usable instruction entry point, single progress log, feature helper, spec template and bootstrap in a temporary repository.
Project-specific rules extend the template without replacing the host authority; optional agent entry points reference the same instructions.
Generated repository boots without other game repositories or network; template update produces an explicit reviewable diff.

features.description: Adopt a pinned rEngine tool capability in the reLith workspace.
acceptance_criteria: Host owner records an approved integration task and adopts a reviewed immutable tool version with a local adapter.
Existing feature IDs, descriptions, progress history and required game gates remain authoritative; host selected checks pass.
Demonstrate the adopted workflow in an independent checkout without rEngine sibling path; report capability and game target scope.
features.deliverable: host-owned spec, pin/adapter commit and gate evidence

features.description: Adopt a pinned rEngine tool capability in the reSource workspace.
acceptance_criteria: Host owner records an approved integration task and adopts a reviewed immutable tool version with a local adapter.
Preserve local verification tiers, progress history, device/manual requirements and ordinary build behavior.
Demonstrate the adopted workflow in an independent checkout without rEngine sibling path; record selected platform/profile scope.
features.deliverable: host-owned spec, pin/adapter commit and gate evidence

features.description: Prove independent tool upgrade and rollback in both consumers.
acceptance_criteria: Use host-owned evidence to show one consumer upgrades while the other remains on its reviewed version.
Both accepted versions pass their declared contract/gates; incompatible contract is rejected with an actionable reason.
Restore the preceding pin/adapter and reproduce the relevant gate; no synchronized game release is required.

features.description: Define the catalog admission and compatibility record for real components.
acceptance_criteria: Owner decides required provenance/license documentation, maintainer, immutable source identity, capability, platforms and independent-consumption evidence.
Schema distinguishes discovered candidate, reviewed recipe and verified consumer adoption; none implies another.
Represent iklib and infra-vr from current source evidence; a hypothetical flecs choice is not marked selected or verified.

features.description: Define reproducible dependency pins and explicit developer overrides.
acceptance_criteria: Choose one consumption mechanism with owner input at F1/F13 and test immutable revision/checksum resolution.
Consumer fixture builds from prepared local sources without implicit home paths or hidden network; missing material fails explicitly.
Local source override is opt-in and appears in evidence; it cannot be advertised as the reviewed release pin.
features.deliverable: dependency manifest/lock contract and consumer fixtures

features.description: Publish a reviewed local iklib consumption recipe and two fixture proofs.
acceptance_criteria: Use the actual iklib CMake target and supported source-tree model at a reviewed revision; do not invent an install package.
Two minimal host-shaped fixtures with different frames/scales compile and run selected solvers without unrelated engine dependencies.
Verify consumer target/options/test isolation; recipe links pending host migrations and makes no completed-game-integration claim.

features.description: Resolve the infra-vr embeddable packaging boundary from both host closures.
acceptance_criteria: Pin and compare both actual INFRA_VR_DIR build closures, target/option collisions, microui ownership and optional transport/platform dependencies.
Agree with the owner whether the fix belongs upstream in infra-vr or in a narrowly scoped consumption recipe; name files and rollback.
Specify both consumer fixture builds and acceptance conditions; do not operate or redesign the backend.

features.description: Prove pinned infra-vr consumption with both host-shaped build fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: Implement the reviewed recipe or consume its owner-landed upstream change at an immutable pin.
Both fixtures build the reporting ABI with one microui definition and no leaked parent options/targets or implicit sibling path.
Exercise a local synthetic report/render callback path and explicit transport configuration; retain upstream-change references if required.

features.description: Complete the existing reSource core IK migration from its owning workspace.
acceptance_criteria: Re-pin current host seam, map a host-owned feature to iklib:F131, and satisfy its unchanged acceptance criteria.
Record old/new pose equivalence and existing IK/contract tests using the pinned library; remove obsolete core solver code.
Record relevant host runtime/manual gates and rollback; do not claim the separate finger migration is included.
features.deliverable: host migration commit and iklib:F131 evidence link

features.description: Complete the existing reLith IK migration with NOLF parameter parity.
acceptance_criteria: Resolve iklib F130 V2 constant comparison against current host before changing solver behavior; use explicit per-host parameters if needed.
Complete F130 criteria with existing host tests and recorded old/new output equivalence; remove replaced production solvers.
Record every reLith game affected by the shared closure, required gates and rollback; adding fingers is a separate task.
features.deliverable: host migration commit and iklib:F130 evidence link

features.description: Complete the separate reSource finger IK migration.
acceptance_criteria: Map the engine-side finger seam outside src/vrik to the existing iklib:F133 scope.
Prove recorded curl/collision/pose behavior equivalence and host gates; remove or reduce duplicate glm solver code to necessary glue.
Retain separate device/manual evidence where required; no NOLF finger capability is claimed.
features.deliverable: host finger migration commit and iklib:F133 evidence link

features.description: Record runtime adoption evidence by engine, game and supported profile.
acceptance_criteria: Reference host-owned migration commits and immutable evidence without changing external feature states from this workspace.
Distinguish NOLF, AVP2, NOLF2 and VtMB plus flat/VR/platform profiles; list verified, unaffected, pending or unsupported honestly.
Each verified row includes component revision, host gates and rollback evidence; coordinate optional iklib:F132 as separate future work.

features.description: Define report-to-reproduction metadata around existing infra-vr reports.
acceptance_criteria: Record report/game/build identity, archived save/input hashes, reproduction steps and expected observation without redefining report transport.
Fixtures distinguish restricted/local assets from exportable metadata and do not embed credentials or game content.
A valid reference resolves to the original local evidence; missing/changed save identity cannot masquerade as a reproduced bug.

features.description: Represent oracle and manual/device evidence without replacing native gates.
acceptance_criteria: Record original-reference version, capture/replay identity, declared tolerance or manual criterion, observer and result.
Demonstrate that unit tests cannot substitute for pending visual/audio/headset criteria and that absent reference is non-passing.
Round-trip representative reLith and reSource evidence shapes without introducing a shared game-format parser.

features.description: Specify an explicit eligibility-checked development evidence export.
acceptance_criteria: Map only allowed development evidence to the current training schemas, preserving source/tool revisions and content hashes.
Reject held-out repository/task identity, withheld fixes/tests, missing provenance and tampered artifacts; ordinary indexes expose no grader material.
Training owner reviews boundary and downstream task; output carries eligibility/outcome rather than invented reward or solved status.
features.deliverable: export contract, classifier fixtures and training mapping spec

features.description: Demonstrate the evidence bridge in the training-owned intake path.
acceptance_criteria: Execute a synthetic eligible export through the actual training intake validation path and preserve all provenance fields.
Frozen/hidden/tampered negative examples fail before ingestion; grader isolation and split authority remain in training.
Record exact versions and results; do not start training, change eval selections or bypass F30 and owner GO.
features.deliverable: training-owned intake spec and synthetic E2E evidence

features.description: Coordinate explicitly reserved workspaces and scarce test resources.
acceptance_criteria: Use explicit resource IDs for workspace/build directory, display or device; avoid global host discovery.
Two competing processes prove exclusive ownership, reliable release after failure, and safe stale-owner recovery without stealing active work.
Planning and CPU-only use require no device; reservation does not grant launch, deployment or production authority.
features.deliverable: local reservation contract and contention tests

features.description: Evaluate one next shared component against real duplicated host needs.
acceptance_criteria: Select one candidate from current host evidence and document API/behavior differences and maintenance cost.
Decide extract, curate existing library, or leave local with reasons and a falsifying acceptance case.
Any accepted implementation is a separately reviewed bounded feature; do not land a speculative subsystem during discovery.

features.description: Prove a new host can adopt a capability without either game engine.
acceptance_criteria: Create a minimal unrelated host layout/object model that consumes one selected capability using public interfaces only.
No reLith/reSource source, globals, game assets or mandatory ECS are needed; remove either game adapter and the fixture still works.
Document what a future flecs-based host would own without claiming or adding a flecs integration absent a selected consumer.
features.deliverable: independent host fixture and conformance evidence

features.description: Define evidence-backed powered-by records for both engine families.
acceptance_criteria: Apply the owner-agreed powered-by minimum from F1; list exact adopted capabilities, pins and verified game/platform/profile rows.
Retain runtime adoption only where separately proven; tools-only adoption is labeled according to the agreed contract.
Do not relabel a pending host, publish branding changes or require an unrelated component to claim a verified capability.

features.description: Audit the harness and decide the next bounded roadmap from measured results.
acceptance_criteria: Validate feature graph, local document links, source/evidence freshness and owner-workspace boundaries; record drift with repair actions.
Compare first-pilot benefit and maintenance cost against F1 measures, including failures and deferred verification.
Review the next work with the owner; preserve accepted feature history and do not expand into an editor/runtime without a named need.
